title: Rework Terms Scheduled for the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Every voluntary rework of a ticket sold under the Air Ticket Fare Brands is priced from the brand's own scheduled terms. Tariffs and Distribution schedules the following quantities brand by brand.

## The quantities

The **change fee** is the fee charged per traveller for a voluntary itinerary change. The **same-day fee** is the fee for a same-day move between flights on the booked routing. The **free-change window** is the number of whole hours after ticket issue in which an itinerary change carries no change fee. The **ceiling on voluntary changes** is the greatest number of voluntary changes permitted on one ticket. **Routing change** and **date change** state whether the origin or destination, and whether the travel dates, may be changed after ticketing. **Fare difference collected** states whether the difference to the new fare is collected on a change. **Residual value handling** states what happens to the unused fare value where the new fare is cheaper. The **standby fee** is the fee to be listed for standby on an earlier flight.

## Schedule

| Fare brand | Change fee (USD) | Same-day fee (USD) | Free-change window (hours) | Ceiling on changes | Routing change | Date change | Fare difference collected | Residual value | Standby fee (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | no | no | yes | forfeited | 0.00 |
| Economy Saver | 199.00 | 99.00 | 0 | 1 | no | yes | yes | forfeited | 75.00 |
| Economy Classic | 149.00 | 75.00 | 24 | 2 | no | yes | yes | placed on a travel credit | 50.00 |
| Economy Flex | 99.00 | 75.00 | 24 | 4 | yes | yes | yes | placed on a travel credit | 25.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | 75.00 | 50.00 | 48 | 4 | yes | yes | yes | placed on a travel credit | 25.00 |
| Business Saver | 50.00 | 25.00 | 48 | 6 | yes | yes | yes | returned to the original form of payment | 0.00 |
| Business Flex | 0.00 | 0.00 | 72 | 12 | yes | yes | yes | returned to the original form of payment | 0.00 |

## Reading the schedule

A brand whose ceiling is scheduled at 0, as Basic Economy Lite is, permits no voluntary change at all; a brand scheduled at 12, as Business Flex is, permits twelve. The two brands scheduled with a free-change window of 0 hours, Basic Economy Lite and Economy Saver, carry no such window; the longest is the 72 hours scheduled for Business Flex.

Routing changes are scheduled as permitted only from Economy Flex upwards. Date changes are scheduled as permitted on every brand but Basic Economy Lite. The fare difference is scheduled as collected on all seven brands alike.

Three treatments of residual value appear in the schedule: forfeited on the two cheapest brands, placed on a travel credit on the three middle brands, and returned to the original form of payment on the two Business brands.

## Hypothetical comparison

Two hypothetical tickets, one Economy Saver and one Business Saver, each undergo a same-day move on the booked routing. The schedule prices the first at 99.00 USD and the second at 25.00 USD. Had the same two tickets undergone an ordinary voluntary change instead, the schedule would price them at 199.00 USD and 50.00 USD.
